decks.domain: Work zones, road rules, restraints and phones

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: A work zone may cover work on the road, its shoulders or.
cards.back: A work zone may cover work on the road, its shoulders or nearby areas, including moving operations such as utility work, surveying or snow removal.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Work-zone signs, pavement markings and flaggers direct traffic through the.
cards.back: Work-zone signs, pavement markings and flaggers direct traffic through the work area or a marked detour. Orange warns of road work.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Work-zone warning signs use a black.
cards.back: Work-zone warning signs use a black legend or symbol on an orange background.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Obey a reduced posted work-zone limit. If no reduced limit is posted.
cards.back: Obey a reduced posted work-zone limit. If no reduced limit is posted, obey the road's normal limit while taking extra care for workers, lane position and road conditions.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: An orange advisory-speed sign identifies a suitable speed for a particular work-zone.
cards.back: An orange advisory-speed sign identifies a suitable speed for a particular work-zone condition; a regulatory reduction is shown by the standard black-and-white speed-limit sign.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: A work-zone flagger has regulatory.
cards.back: A work-zone flagger has regulatory authority. Follow the flagger's traffic directions.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Yield to work vehicles displaying flashing or rotating amber.
cards.back: Yield to work vehicles displaying flashing or rotating amber warning lights, and slow as you approach the work area.

decks.domain: Work zones, road rules, restraints and phones

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: When lanes narrow or close near workers, move to another lane if.
cards.back: When lanes narrow or close near workers, move to another lane if possible. Otherwise create more separation within your own lane without crossing its boundaries.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Moving work vehicles may travel extremely slowly or stop in the.
cards.back: Moving work vehicles may travel extremely slowly or stop in the traffic lane. Slow, yield and follow their displayed arrows or directions.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: When entering a work zone, watch speed signs, position the.
cards.back: When entering a work zone, watch speed signs, position the vehicle away from workers where possible and prepare for unexpected changes.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Enter or leave a controlled-access road only through an authorized.
cards.back: Enter or leave a controlled-access road only through an authorized entrance or exit, and obey signs excluding particular vehicle types.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Reversing on a.
cards.back: Reversing on a controlled-access roadway is prohibited.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Do not enter a reversible express lane when.
cards.back: Do not enter a reversible express lane when its access gates are already closed or are closing.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: When descending a hill, do not coast.
cards.back: When descending a hill, do not coast with the transmission or gears in neutral.

decks.domain: Work zones, road rules, restraints and phones

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Driving is unlawful when alcohol, an illegal or prescribed drug, or another.
cards.back: Driving is unlawful when alcohol, an illegal or prescribed drug, or another substance impairs safe vehicle operation. A prescription does not excuse driving impairment.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Reckless driving means operating with disregard for the safety of people or.
cards.back: Reckless driving means operating with disregard for the safety of people or property; the handbook gives unsafe speed, weaving and improper passing as examples.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Street racing includes competing with other vehicles, accelerating or maneuvering to.
cards.back: Street racing includes competing with other vehicles, accelerating or maneuvering to keep a competing driver from passing, or competing against a clock.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Aggressive driving involves operating with an intent to harass, intimidate, injure or.
cards.back: Aggressive driving involves operating with an intent to harass, intimidate, injure or obstruct another person. Examples include tailgating, cutting someone off and blocking a pass or lane change.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: The handbook's reckless-stunt-driving description includes drag racing or laying drags in disregard.
cards.back: The handbook's reckless-stunt-driving description includes drag racing or laying drags in disregard of safety on a highway or on private property without the owner's express permission.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Outside business and residential districts, trucks and vehicles towing trailers must leave.
cards.back: Outside business and residential districts, trucks and vehicles towing trailers must leave enough space between similar vehicles for an overtaking vehicle to enter safely; closely grouped caravanning is prohibited.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: The handbook prohibits trailers wider than.
cards.back: The handbook prohibits trailers wider than eight feet six inches on Georgia highways.

decks.domain: Work zones, road rules, restraints and phones

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Passengers may not ride inside a house trailer or another.
cards.back: Passengers may not ride inside a house trailer or another towed trailer while it is moving on a street or highway.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Cross a divided-road median, barrier or unpaved separating.
cards.back: Cross a divided-road median, barrier or unpaved separating strip only at an authorized opening or crossover.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Do not use a headset or another device that.
cards.back: Do not use a headset or another device that impairs hearing while driving, or wear anything that blocks vision.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Do not drive an overloaded vehicle when passengers or freight obstruct the.
cards.back: Do not drive an overloaded vehicle when passengers or freight obstruct the driver's view or interfere with vehicle operation. Passengers must not occupy a position that hinders the view or control.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Open a door beside moving traffic only when.
cards.back: Open a door beside moving traffic only when safe and without interfering with passing vehicles or bicycles.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Follow the posted direction of a one-way road unless a traffic-control device.
cards.back: Follow the posted direction of a one-way road unless a traffic-control device or authorized traffic director directs otherwise; the handbook also recognizes official emergency-vehicle exceptions.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Give the appropriate hand, arm or.
cards.back: Give the appropriate hand, arm or brake-light signal when slowing or stopping suddenly.

decks.domain: Work zones, road rules, restraints and phones

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Use high beams only in rural.
cards.back: Use high beams only in rural surroundings when other vehicles are not nearby.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Headlights are required beginning half an hour after sunset through half.
cards.back: Headlights are required beginning half an hour after sunset through half an hour before sunrise, whenever it rains, and whenever visibility is limited.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Dim the headlights within five hundred feet of an approaching.
cards.back: Dim the headlights within five hundred feet of an approaching vehicle and when following another vehicle within two hundred feet.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Use low beams on illuminated roads, in rain, fog, snow or.
cards.back: Use low beams on illuminated roads, in rain, fog, snow or smoke, and when the visible distance falls below two hundred feet.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Keep headlight lenses clean, make sure the.
cards.back: Keep headlight lenses clean, make sure the lamps work, and periodically have their aim checked.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: At night, choose a speed that permits.
cards.back: At night, choose a speed that permits stopping within the road distance your headlights illuminate.

decks.domain: Work zones, road rules, restraints and phones

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Slow at night when approaching a curve or oncoming traffic. With greatly.
cards.back: Slow at night when approaching a curve or oncoming traffic. With greatly reduced visibility, use the edge line as a lane guide, or the centerline if no edge line is present.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: For night driving, keep the windshield clean and look carefully.
cards.back: For night driving, keep the windshield clean and look carefully for signs, pedestrians and vehicles stopped along the road's edge.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Do not continue driving when tired, and.
cards.back: Do not continue driving when tired, and do not stop on the roadway at night.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Each front-seat occupant of a passenger vehicle must use the lap-and-shoulder belt.
cards.back: Each front-seat occupant of a passenger vehicle must use the lap-and-shoulder belt. All passenger-vehicle occupants younger than eighteen must use a safety belt wherever seated.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: The handbook describes Georgia's belt law as primary enforcement, allowing an officer.
cards.back: The handbook describes Georgia's belt law as primary enforcement, allowing an officer to stop and cite a belt violation without first seeing another offense.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Correct belt use helps retain the occupant in the vehicle, distribute crash.
cards.back: Correct belt use helps retain the occupant in the vehicle, distribute crash force over stronger body areas, and prevent contact with the interior or other occupants.

decks.domain: Work zones, road rules, restraints and phones

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: A driver carrying a child younger than eight ordinarily must use an.
cards.back: A driver carrying a child younger than eight ordinarily must use an approved child restraint matched to the child's height and weight. The handbook excludes taxis and public transit and notes additional limited exemptions.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Distracted driving diverts attention from operating the vehicle. The handbook's examples include.
cards.back: Distracted driving diverts attention from operating the vehicle. The handbook's examples include phone use, reading, eating, grooming, navigation-device use and adjusting audio; passengers and animals can also distract.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Georgia's described due-care rule prohibits activities.
cards.back: Georgia's described due-care rule prohibits activities that distract from safe vehicle operation.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Unless on official business, do not follow a responding fire vehicle or.
cards.back: Unless on official business, do not follow a responding fire vehicle or other emergency vehicle closer than two hundred feet, and do not park within five hundred feet of fire apparatus stopped for an alarm.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: When litter is thrown, dropped or deposited from a.
cards.back: When litter is thrown, dropped or deposited from a motor vehicle, the handbook assigns responsibility to the vehicle's operator.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: The litter-control prohibition covers discarding waste on public or private property and.
cards.back: The litter-control prohibition covers discarding waste on public or private property and in the state's waters; discarded materials and rubbish fall within the stated definition.

decks.domain: Work zones, road rules, restraints and phones

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: The handbook's hands-free rule prohibits holding or supporting a phone or standalone.
cards.back: The handbook's hands-free rule prohibits holding or supporting a phone or standalone electronic device with any part of the body while operating on a highway.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: The described hands-free arrangements use a mounted holder, wireless equipment or headphones.
cards.back: The described hands-free arrangements use a mounted holder, wireless equipment or headphones; a device that impairs hearing remains separately prohibited by the handbook's hearing rule.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: The hands-free section prohibits writing, reading or sending text.
cards.back: The hands-free section prohibits writing, reading or sending text communications, including messages, email and internet data, while driving.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: The hands-free section also prohibits watching, recording.
cards.back: The hands-free section also prohibits watching, recording or broadcasting a movie or video while driving.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Approach a flashing-light postal-service vehicle or a vehicle with active sanitation workers.
cards.back: Approach a flashing-light postal-service vehicle or a vehicle with active sanitation workers cautiously. Unless an officer directs otherwise, change into a lane not beside it when safety and traffic allow.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: If changing lanes for a covered postal or sanitation vehicle is impossible.
cards.back: If changing lanes for a covered postal or sanitation vehicle is impossible, unlawful or unsafe, reduce to a reasonable speed for conditions and prepare to stop.
